title: Carry explicit approval through the ModuleRuntime boundary
goal: Allow ModuleRuntime to complete approval-required work only after an explicit ApprovalGate decision for the concrete module capability.
context: M6 and M8 composition roots already expose ApprovalGate to the orchestration layer but do not inject it into ModuleRuntime. As a result, a Skill can be approved at its own boundary and still fail at ModuleRuntime even when a gate exists; ModuleRuntime must ask for approval against the concrete module intent without weakening policy.
forbidden_changes: Never infer module approval from a Skill-level approval or a Settings toggle.
Missing or rejected approval must fail closed before moduleInvoked.
Do not change workspace path validation, tool capabilities, UI, or provider/GGUF behavior.
acceptance_criteria: M6 and M8 composition roots inject the existing approval gate into ModuleRuntime.
ModuleRuntime requests approval for the concrete module intent only when policy requires it.
Missing and rejected approval fail closed and produce no moduleInvoked event.
An approved module completes and emits moduleInvoked and moduleCompleted.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the build or tests fail, inspect the exact failing boundary and repair only the scoped task while preserving fail-closed behavior.
